owner_direction: Research specific architectures and innovations with agents before further construction; do not confine comparison to one repository. Commit reviewable slices and test theoretical changes.
application: Four bounded read-only architecture packets challenge configuration/plugin activation, durable consultation/execution, execution arms and memory/cache architecture. Root synthesizes comparisons and finite theoretical counterexamples in the existing allowlist. No new product construction or live trials.
preserved_bounds: Original campaign deadline, reserve, zero metered spend/reset redemption and operational non-goals remain unchanged. Latest Owner direction permits up to10 active agents; this addendum admits at most4 concurrent read-only discovery workers plus root, superseding the initial two-worker limit for these packets only. Final independent reviews use two workers.
research_questions: Can lifecycle callback success, published service metadata and actual task-bound configuration diverge, and which candidate keeps authority and dispatch coherent?
Can workflow/journal/transport receipts omit rejected decisions or accept obsolete replies, and which candidate preserves current consultation authority and accounting?
completion_gate: Pin primary implementation evidence; distinguish existing canonical coverage from new findings; compare complete alternatives; execute a bounded theoretical counterexample and guarded positive control for each selected discriminator; integrate exact-candidate gate/review and publication.
